entities.name: Mike O'Donnell objects to starting the photo without Ed Freedman

entities.name: Ed Freedman explains his tardiness as battling a dark wizard

entities.description: In response to Ed's attempt to flirt, Muffy Campanella silently pretends to vomit, indicating her disgust or amusement.

document_metadata.title: 33、INT. FITCH SENIOR HIGH SCHOOL/CAFETERIA - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Mike, humiliated by Stan and rejected by Maggie, is publicly mocked when Stan puts ice cream in his hat; Alex watches in disgust as Mike leaves, humiliated.

entities.name: Mike enters the cafeteria with a burn mark on his pants
entities.description: Mike walks into the lunchroom carrying a bag lunch, drawing attention due to a black burn mark on the crotch of his pants.

entities.name: Gaysian mocks Mike as 'Hot Pants'
entities.description: A student referred to as Gaysian sees Mike, points at him, and yells 'Go Hot Pants! Do your dance, Girl!' inciting laughter.

entities.name: Cafeteria erupts in laughter at Mike's expense
entities.description: After Gaysian's comment, the entire cafeteria turns to look at Mike and bursts into laughter, ridiculing him.

entities.name: Students watch video of Mike's 'fire dance' on their phones
entities.description: As Mike walks through the cafeteria, multiple students are seen watching a video of his embarrassing 'fire dance' on their phones.

entities.description: When Mike attempts to sit with a group of socially marginalized students, one of them tells him they 'feel his pain' but implies he is still unwelcome.

entities.description: As Mike approaches the table where Maggie and the Wonder Bras are sitting, the girls deliberately avoid looking at him and pretend he is not there.

entities.description: Mike greets Maggie and the other girls at the table, introducing himself as 'Mark' despite having already been known as Mike.

entities.description: Jamie notices Mike has a bag lunch and calls him 'sped' (short for special ed), ridiculing him for it.

entities.description: Samantha informs Mike that their table is for V.I.P.s only and that he is a 'NIP'—Not Important—telling him to leave.

entities.description: Mike challenges Maggie, asking why she associates with girls who treat him so poorly.

entities.name: Maggie rejects Mike due to having a boyfriend
entities.description: Maggie tells Mike she appreciates his earlier gesture in class but clarifies she already has a boyfriend, indirectly rejecting his interest.

entities.name: Mike receives a phone call from Scarlet
entities.description: Mike's older Blackberry phone rings, showing a caller ID for 'Scarlet,' which he sees before sending the call to voicemail.

entities.name: Jamie mocks Mike's outdated phone
entities.description: Jamie comments that Mike still gets calls, calling his older model phone 'so 2007,' highlighting its obsolescence.

entities.name: Samantha compares Mike's phone to her grandfather's
entities.description: Samantha adds to the mockery by saying her grandfather owns the same kind of phone as Mike, further humiliating him.

entities.description: After Mike's outburst, Stan steps toward him, standing a full foot taller and physically intimidating him in front of the cafeteria.

entities.name: Mike backs down under public scrutiny

entities.name: Stan humiliates Mike by placing ice cream in his hat
entities.description: Stan removes Mike's hat, fills it with ice cream from Maggie's tray, puts it back on Mike's head, and smushes it down as a public act of degradation.

entities.name: Stan mocks Mike with a pun and tells him to leave
entities.description: After smashing the ice cream into Mike's hat, Stan tells him to 'make like Tom and Cruise,' mocking him with a pun on 'Tom Cruise' to command his exit.

entities.name: Mike walks out of the cafeteria covered in ice cream
entities.description: Humiliated and dripping with ice cream, Mike turns and leaves the cafeteria in silence, enduring public shame.

entities.name: Maggie criticizes Stan's behavior
entities.description: After the incident, Maggie tells Stan that his actions were 'so not cool,' expressing disapproval of how he treated Mike.

entities.name: Stan dismisses Maggie's criticism and offers to buy a new ice cream
entities.description: Stan responds to Maggie's disapproval by shrugging it off and offering to buy her another ice cream, showing indifference to the emotional impact of his actions.

entities.name: Alex observes the incident with visible disgust
entities.description: From a back table, Alex shakes his head in disapproval and disgust at Stan's bullying behavior toward Mike.

document_metadata.summary: Mike reunites with Scarlet in a tunnel, they embrace and kiss, then leave together, agreeing not to tell their kids, especially Maggie, about the encounter.

entities.name: Mike takes Scarlet's hand and walks with her out of the tunnel
entities.description: After their embrace and kiss, Mike takes Scarlet's hand and they exit the tunnel together.

entities.name: Mike suggests keeping their experience a secret from the children
